original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.
Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: Prove the complete shortest-word coefficient multiplicity distribution for the unsigned one-source dirty connector over every finite characteristic, with a divisor-sum formula and prime/composite equidistribution criterion.
scope_change_reason: The live handoffs assign five-source and signed-ring characteristic optima elsewhere. This self-contained side result changes the binary coefficient assumption and answers a different exact question: how many optimal schedules realize each coefficient. It does not extend a source-count census or claim a supplier improvement.
bottleneck_link: The law identifies the exact scheduling freedom at a dirty recursive boundary, including the failure of prime-field coefficient uniformity in composite characteristic. No selected consumer is supplied, so this is a scheduling side result, not a paid-profile or kappa gain.
stop_rule: Finish one uniform counting proof, bounded exact enumerations, dirty noncommuting replay and source-bound publication checks; no larger supplier construction or search.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the all-characteristic divisor formula and prime/composite criterion. verify.py compares exact DP and position-subset enumerations, literal dirty coefficient words, complete length classes and noncommuting dense replay, with refusal controls and a generated source-hash receipt.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Can the one-source coefficient spectra constrain the joint coefficient demands of a multi-source unsigned connector?
open_questions.why_it_matters: One-source uniformity fails in composite characteristic. A usable simultaneous obstruction could prune multi-source schedules without assuming independent choices.
open_questions.first_step: Project one pinned multi-source source path onto each source and compare the attainable joint readout coefficient tuples with the marginal spectra. Retain boundary correlations.
open_questions.blocked_by: Marginal counts alone do not enforce simultaneous readout positions; this package proves no multi-source obstruction.

open_questions.question: Can a concrete recursive caller exploit distinct minimum-length schedules to reduce physical routing while preserving the full call bill?
open_questions.why_it_matters: All counted words have the same operator bill, but physical access, dispatch and restoration can depend on their order.
open_questions.first_step: Extract one actual one-source caller with exact characteristic, immutable source, unobserved target and dirty connector, then price two distinct optimal words including all head returns.
open_questions.blocked_by: No selected-supplier caller or word-dependent physical tariff is bound here.
